title: Skip the 2000-character JSON prompt and use a much simpler prompt to get better…
content:
Skip the 2000-character JSON prompt and use a much simpler prompt to get better Seedance results.

Give Seedance more creative freedom (avoid over-constraining the prompt) to produce more impressive outputs.
